violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. PIC’S FOOD SAFETY MANAGER CERTIFICATE WAS EXPIRED.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. YOU MUST OBTAIN A CERTIFICATE BY SEPTEMBER 28TH.

out_items.name: Toilet facilities properly constructed, supplied, and cleaned

violations.title: Covered Receptacle in Women's Toilet
violations.observation: There is no covered refuse container for the disposal of feminine napkins in the ladies room stall.
violations.corrective_action: A toilet room used by females shall be provided with a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins. CDI: PIC PROVIDED COVERED TRASH CAN DURING INSPECTION.
